reviews.review:
I just couldn't keep playing this game, it's not fun at all.

-Pros-
HaHa SMG goes brrrrr
weapon designs are okay
maps are whatever
thats all really
-Cons-
Enemies are the same and rather than making few unique and challenging enemies, they just place lots of the same mobs over and over, 
Melee is bad, guns are unsatisfactory, combat is just terrible in general, and this game is all about combat
For a lot of chests and doors, you need RNG drops
Stats are a mess in general, never really felt stronger or tougher the more I leveled up
story is there i guess, didn't care at all

I suggest you skip this one
